name: Turtlements

description:
We offer a wide range of features that let you consolidate your notes and recordings into a single document, so you don't need to use different apps to combine mind maps, drawings, and text.

Our app lets you create unique charts and keep your notes organized and concise — without ads or additional subscriptions.

You don't have to worry about other devices either, because Turtlements works the same way on all of them. That way, you can share your notes no matter who you send your notebook to.

Turtlements offers you the following features:

• Text Editing

• Drawings, sketches, and handwritten notes

• Create and customize mind maps

• Import Images and PDF Documents

• Operating-system-independent usability of the files

• Manage all your documents using a general-purpose file system

In addition, we're working on offering you even more diverse options for creating and designing your documents in future updates!

We're also open to feedback so we can improve our app and tailor it to your needs. So if you have an idea or a suggestion, please feel free to share it with us!

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
